card.title: Strong Weekly Sales Performance
card.headline: Chain sales rose to €47.23M, beating forecast by 1.4% [f1, f2]
bullets: Sales increased 19.9% versus the prior week [f3].
All store types posted positive forecast variance, with type c at +3.4% [f10].
Same‑store customer visits were down 3.2% year‑over‑year while average basket size rose 4.4% [f15, f16].
card.action: Review traffic drivers in stores that are below forecast to boost visits this week.

card.title: Holiday Timing Boosts Store Type C
card.headline: Early signal: Store type C sales are +16.0% above forecast
bullets: 91% of stores moved the same way [f2]
Peak on Tue 23 Dec was +39% versus forecast [f6]
Sales dipped to -1% on Dec 24 then rose to +4% on Dec 27 [f7, f8]
card.action: Review holiday stock‑up plans to sustain the uplift this week

card.title: Low‑Lift Store Promo Review
card.headline: Low‑lift stores are delivering far below the chain median promo lift
bullets: 111 stores fall in the lowest‑lift group with a median lift of +22% [f2, f3]
The chain’s pooled causal promo lift is +37.8% and the chain median store lift is +40% [f1, f4]
Weekly promo revenue at stake in this group is €405.0k [f6]
Lift is measured versus non‑promo weeks and may include pull‑forward
card.action: Randomize half the low‑lift group to an alternative mechanic for the next two promo cycles [f11]

card.title: Promo2 Enrollment Impact Overview
card.headline: Early signals show a modest lift of about +2.9%, though some rebound effect may be present [f1, f6]
bullets: The estimated effect is +2.9% with a 95% confidence interval from +1.1% to +4.6% [f1, f2, f3]
Trend‑adjusted estimate suggests a +4.7% lift [f4]
Analysis covers 98 newly enrolled stores versus 519 comparison stores [f8, f9]
card.action: Review the enrollment criteria and consider a follow‑up test to isolate rebound effects.
